scenarios.scenario: Move the model browser between side docks

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the model browser is docked to the left edge of the workspace
the user drags its header to the right edge of the workspace
the model browser docks at the right edge
the viewport occupies the workspace to its left
the user drags its header to the left edge of the workspace
the model browser docks at the left edge

scenarios.scenario: Inspect the drawing browser tree menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is active in the MCAD Software
the drawing browser is visible
the user opens the drawing browser menu
the menu offers Expand All, Collapse All and Help
the drawing sheet remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Collapse and expands the drawing browser tree

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open in the MCAD Software with drawing resources and a sheet
the browser has expanded branches containing nested entries
the user opens the drawing browser menu
the user chooses Collapse All
the drawing resources and sheet remain visible as collapsed branches
their nested entries are hidden
the drawing sheet remains visible
the user opens the drawing browser menu
the user chooses Expand All
nested entries under the drawing resources and sheet are displayed
the drawing sheet remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Filter drawing browser entries while retaining their parent branches

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open in the MCAD Software with border entries in its resources and sheet
the drawing browser branches are expanded
the user opens the drawing browser search field
the user enters "Border"
matching border entries are displayed beneath their respective parent branches
matching text is highlighted
unrelated browser entries are hidden
the drawing sheet remains visible
the user clears the search text
the unfiltered drawing browser tree is displayed
the user closes the empty search field
the search field is hidden

scenarios.scenario: Show an empty drawing browser search result

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open in the MCAD Software with browser entries
the drawing browser search field is open
the user enters "zzq-nomatch"
a no-results message is displayed in place of the browser tree
the drawing sheet remains visible
the user clears the search text
the unfiltered drawing browser tree is displayed

scenarios.scenario: Switch the selected drawing browser entry

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open in the MCAD Software with a border and title block
the sheet branch is expanded in the drawing browser
the user selects the sheet border entry in the drawing browser
the border entry is highlighted in the browser
the drawing sheet remains displayed
the user selects the sheet title block entry in the drawing browser
the title block entry is highlighted in the browser
the border entry is no longer highlighted as the active selection
the drawing sheet remains displayed

scenarios.scenario: Search while the drawing browser floats

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open in the MCAD Software with browser entries
the drawing browser floats over the drawing sheet
the user opens the floating browser search field
the user enters "zzq-nomatch"
the floating browser displays a no-results message instead of its tree
the drawing sheet remains visible behind the browser
the user clears the search text
the unfiltered drawing browser tree is displayed in the floating panel
the user closes the empty search field
the search field is hidden
the browser remains floating over the sheet

scenarios.scenario: Move the drawing browser between side docks

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is active in the MCAD Software
the drawing browser is docked on the left
the user drags the drawing browser header to the right edge of the workspace
the drawing browser docks on the right
its drawing resources and sheet tree remain visible
the drawing sheet remains visible to its left
the user drags the drawing browser header to the left edge of the workspace
the drawing browser docks on the left
the drawing sheet remains visible to its right

scenarios.scenario: Collapse and reopen one drawing browser branch

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open in the MCAD Software with a sheet and drawing resources
the sheet and drawing resources branches are expanded in the browser
the nested title block branch is expanded
the user selects the expansion control beside the sheet branch
the sheet branch collapses and its child entries are hidden
the drawing resources branch remains expanded
the drawing sheet remains visible
the user selects the expansion control beside the sheet branch again
the sheet branch expands and its child entries are displayed
the nested title block branch appears expanded
the drawing resources branch remains expanded

scenarios.scenario: Find drawing entries inside a collapsed resource branch

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open in the MCAD Software with a border resource and a sheet border
the drawing resources branch is collapsed in the browser
the user opens the drawing browser search field
the user enters "Border"
the filtered tree shows the matching border resource under its parent branches
the filtered tree shows the matching sheet border
the matching text is highlighted
the user clears the search text
the unfiltered tree is restored
the drawing resources branch is collapsed
the drawing sheet remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Collapse and reopens the part origin branch during sketch editing

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
Sketch1 is being edited
the model browser shows an expanded Origin branch and other document entries
the user selects the expansion control beside Origin
the Origin branch collapses and its child entries are hidden
the other document entries remain visible in the browser
the sketch remains displayed in the viewport
the user selects the expansion control beside Origin again
the Origin branch expands and its child entries are displayed
the other document entries remain visible
the sketch remains displayed in the viewport
